newsitem.title: CANADA: Canbra Foods amends plan of arrangement.
newsitem.headline: Canbra Foods amends plan of arrangement.

text.p: Canbra Foods Ltd said on Tuesday that it amended its plan of arrangement for the proposed takeover of minority shares by Hartford Securities, a wholly owned unit of Pocklington Financial (1996) Corp.

Under the changes, minority shareholders would receive for each Canbra share one class A preference share of the amlgamated company, to be redeemed on the effective date of the deal for C$18, and one class B preference share, to be redeemed for C$4.63.

The company said that at a total of C$22.63, the amendments translated into C$1.63 more a share than provided under the previous plan and meant the price was higher than the average of the high and low ends of the firm's value determined by Midland Walwyn.
The effective date of the transaction was now expected to be December 18.
Canbra also said that only a majority of shares would need to be voted in support of the plan for approval, instead of the previous two-thirds.
A special meeting, to be held in Lethbridge, was adjourned to December 16, Canbra said.
